WITH year_months AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS month,
    COALESCE(p.payment_value, 0)::NUMERIC AS payment_value
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
),
complete_years AS (
  SELECT
    year
  FROM year_months
  GROUP BY year
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT month) = 12
)
SELECT
  ym.year,
  ym.month,
  ABS(SUM(ym.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
FROM year_months ym
WHERE ym.year IN (
  SELECT year FROM complete_years ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 2
)
GROUP BY ym.year, ym.month
ORDER BY ym.year, ym.month;
